title: Unique V2 identity for governed generated-artifact dispatcher

phases.objective: Assign a fresh unique GitHub Actions workflow identity while preserving the trusted comment command, exact-head writer delegation, direct canonical publication, permissions, and fail-closed behavior.

e2e_journeys.actor: trusted repository collaborator and GitHub Actions workflow registry
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A trusted /refresh-generated-artifacts <exact-sha> comment after the V2 identity reaches main
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: GitHub registers Governed Generated Artifact Refresh Dispatch V2 and the workflow directly publishes a structured decision containing an observed delegated writer run or a typed blocking reason.
steps: Change only the workflow display identity to a unique V2 name.
Preserve trusted-main checkout, exact PR head validation, explicit refresh label, protected-branch rejection, and typed writer confirmation.
Preserve direct canonical publication before enforcement.
After merge, issue one exact-head command and require an actual workflow run.
assertions: The workflow name is exactly Governed Generated Artifact Refresh Dispatch V2.
The canonical report contract and artifact names remain unchanged.
Permissions remain actions:write, contents:read, issues:write, and pull-requests:read with no contents:write.
No candidate code checkout, direct repository mutation, force push, migration, deployment, provider call, credential access, or external send is introduced.
HTTP 204 alone remains insufficient; passed evidence requires delegated_run_observed=true and delegated_run_id.

phases.objective: Observe one exact-head issue-comment run under the V2 identity and its delegated writer run ID.
Continue fail-closed handling for stale heads, missing labels, untrusted authors, protected branches, rejected dispatch, and unobserved writer runs.
This repository workflow identity repair performs no provider or deployment canary.
This repair grants no runtime, migration, provider, credential, deployment, or Production authority.
